scoringKey.name: Clave de puntuación pareada reconstruida de DPO Express V 6.0
scoringKey.publishPolicy: IMMUTABLE_AFTER_PUBLISH; create a new version to change any weight, polarity, scale assignment or composite formula

algorithm.pairAnswerStorage: Store selectedMoreReactiveCode. The other reactive in the pair is implicitly selectedLess.
algorithm.scaleRawScore: Sum the seven reactive contributions assigned to the scale.
algorithm.compositeRawScore: Arithmetic mean of the raw scale scores in the composite; do not average scale deciles.
algorithm.numericCompatibilityNote: For this legacy key, calculate composite averages and compare norm thresholds using IEEE-754 binary64 semantics (JavaScript Number) so boundary cases reproduce Excel. Persist the resulting number as a decimal string.
algorithm.normLookup: Excel LOOKUP semantics: choose the last threshold whose minRaw is less than or equal to the raw score.
algorithm.rounding: Do not add manual rounding. The scoring key version explicitly pins EXCEL_BINARY64 compatibility.
